techniques: Exact published source id37; dual _r (widening 32x32->64 multiply) and _t (16-bit-limb multiply) implementations selected by EIK_SEL=(L'\0'-1<0), not target #ifdefs; EIK_STATS is optional. Uses extensive static anchor/coefficient tables including 256-entry paired exp tables and 32/64-cell tables. Sigmoid/tanh cell approximations are cubic; exp uses cubic cell polynomials after ln2-scaled power-of-two range reduction and table lookup. Fast paths classify sign/exponent, handle tiny/large/saturated inputs, and accept guarded rounded estimates; midpoint/hard cases use integer comparison/refinement routines plus sparse exceptional-word corrections. No source edits or optimization.
